_note: CI gates for scripts/balance_report.py --check (Balance smoke step: stage 3 Colossus, average tier, 5 heroes x 3 seeds). Gates sit just past the 2026-11-22 baseline so regressions fail; targets are for tuning, not gated. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-22-balance-harness.md.

rooms._note: Room status smoke (balance_rooms.py, stage 3 rooms incl. 2 Cinder rooms per hero, average tier, 3 seeds). Existing lift/lands gates sit well past the 2026-11-22 baseline so only regressions fail. The Cinder death-rate cap is a loose CI tripwire (n is small); the measured Maw/Kite trim and the >=1 status-involved-death-per-average-Normal-run floor are documented in run_estimate and enforced when frozen stage rates are present. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-22-room-status-harness.md.

run_estimate._note: Per-run status-involved deaths = sum(path_rooms_excluding_boss[s] * rate[s]). Path counts are critical_path_rooms(): mean entry-to-Colossus maze distance (boss room excluded). Stage 3 mixes Maw/Kite vs other rooms at ember_cinder_natural_share (~10% of unforced combat courts in the room-fixture set) because the harness oversamples Cinder rooms. frozen_stage_status_involved_rate fills stages the CI smoke does not run (filled from the PR's stages 1-9 average Normal sweep). status_involved = Poison/Burn/Bleed active at the killing blow, a landing within the 10 s / 600-frame lift window, or a direct Poison/Bleed tick kill. Burn itself cannot kill.

frozen_stage_status_involved_rate._note: Average-tier Normal rates from the PR's stages 1-9 sweep (5 heroes, 3 natural rooms/stage, +4 Cinder rooms on stage 3, 2 seeds; 310 fights) on the 12/5 Burn-proc ROM with lethal Poison/Bleed. Stage 3 is the blended natural-share rate (10% Maw/Kite + 90% other Ember courts); CI overwrites it with a live measurement when both Cinder and other Ember rooms are present.
